senses.en: recorded as a movie or video

example.en: She gave a filmed interview about her new book.
example.zh: 她就自己的新书接受了一次录像采访。

senses.en: past tense and past participle of film: recorded on camera
senses.zh: 拍摄（film 的过去式和过去分词）

example.en: They filmed the entire match yesterday.
example.zh: 他们昨天拍摄了整场比赛。

senses.en: a building where bodies of dead people are burned

example.en: The funeral service was held at the local crematorium.
example.zh: 葬礼仪式在当地火葬场举行。

senses.en: unwilling or reluctant to do something

example.en: He was loth to leave his hometown.
example.zh: 他不愿意离开家乡。

senses.en: drawn by hand without tools like rulers

example.en: He did a freehand sketch of the building.
example.zh: 他徒手画了一幅建筑草图。

senses.en: by hand without using drawing tools

example.en: She drew the circle freehand.
example.zh: 她徒手画了这个圆。

senses.en: a philosophy emphasizing intuition and the spiritual over the material and empirical

example.en: Transcendentalism influenced many American writers in the nineteenth century.
example.zh: 超验主义影响了十九世纪的许多美国作家。

senses.en: a keyboard instrument that makes sound when air is pushed past metal reeds

example.en: She played a hymn on the old harmonium.
example.zh: 她用那台旧簧风琴弹奏了一首赞美诗。

senses.en: the religion based on the life and teachings of Jesus Christ

example.en: Christianity is one of the world's major religions.
example.zh: 基督教是世界主要宗教之一。

senses.en: Christians of the world considered as a group

example.en: The war divided European Christianity.
example.zh: 这场战争分裂了欧洲基督教界。

senses.en: not clearly or exactly

example.en: I vaguely remember meeting her at a conference.
example.zh: 我依稀记得在一次会议上见过她。

senses.en: in an unclear way when speaking

example.en: He answered vaguely and changed the subject.
example.zh: 他回答得含含糊糊，然后转移了话题。

senses.en: two performers who work together

example.en: The duo released their first album last year.
example.zh: 这个二人组合去年发行了首张专辑。

senses.en: two people or things seen as a pair

example.en: The sisters make a great duo in the kitchen.
example.zh: 这对姐妹在厨房里配合得很好。

senses.en: trouble or difficulty caused to someone

example.en: We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the delay.
example.zh: 我们对延误造成的任何不便表示歉意。

senses.en: to cause someone trouble or difficulty

example.en: The roadworks will inconvenience drivers for a week.
example.zh: 道路施工将给司机带来一周的不便。

senses.en: a division into two completely opposite parts or groups

example.en: There is a sharp dichotomy between his public image and private life.
example.zh: 他的公众形象和私生活之间存在鲜明的对立。

senses.en: a strong band of tissue in the body that connects bones

example.en: She tore a ligament in her knee while skiing.
example.zh: 她滑雪时膝盖的韧带撕裂了。

senses.en: the state of living in or using a building or space

example.en: The hotel has an occupancy rate of over 90 percent in summer.
example.zh: 这家酒店夏季的入住率超过90%。

senses.en: the act of taking possession of a place

example.en: The occupancy of the old house was recorded in the archives.
example.zh: 这座老房子的占用情况记录在档案中。

senses.en: a usual or fixed way of doing things

example.en: Checking email is part of my morning routine.
example.zh: 查看电子邮件是我早晨例行公事的一部分。

senses.en: ordinary and not unusual

example.en: The doctor asked some routine questions about my health.
example.zh: 医生问了一些关于我健康的常规问题。

senses.en: an amount equal to one or more parts of every hundred

example.en: About 60 percent of the students passed the exam.
example.zh: 大约百分之六十的学生通过了考试。

senses.en: approval or consent to do something

example.en: You need permission to enter the restricted area.
example.zh: 进入限制区域需要许可。

senses.en: a formal or official authorization

example.en: The council gave permission for the event to proceed.
example.zh: 委员会批准该活动继续进行。

senses.en: The act of recognizing and naming someone or something.

example.en: The identification of the virus took several days.
example.zh: 该病毒的鉴定花了几天时间。

senses.en: Something that proves who a person is.

example.en: Please bring some form of identification.
example.zh: 请携带某种身份证明。

senses.en: A feeling of understanding or closeness with someone or something.

example.en: Her identification with the characters made the novel memorable.
example.zh: 她与书中人物的认同使这部小说令人难忘。

senses.en: a new member of a group or organization

example.en: The team welcomed two new recruits this month.
example.zh: 团队本月迎来了两名新成员。

senses.en: to find and hire people for a job or organization

example.en: The company plans to recruit more staff next year.
example.zh: 公司计划明年招聘更多员工。

senses.en: a horizontal bar used as a support or barrier

example.en: She held the rail as she walked down the stairs.
example.zh: 她下楼梯时扶着栏杆。

senses.en: one of the metal bars that trains run on

example.en: Workers replaced a damaged section of rail.
example.zh: 工人更换了一段损坏的铁轨。

senses.en: to complain angrily or criticize strongly

example.en: He railed against the unfair decision.
example.zh: 他愤怒地抱怨这个不公平的决定。

senses.en: a long passage inside a building with doors leading off it
senses.zh: 建筑物内两侧有门的走廊

example.en: She waited in the corridor outside the office.
example.zh: 她在办公室外的走廊里等候。

senses.en: a narrow strip of land or route that connects two places
senses.zh: 连接两地的狭长地带或通道

example.en: The railway runs along a narrow corridor between the mountains.
example.zh: 铁路沿着山间一条狭窄的通道延伸。

senses.en: to put a limit on something

example.en: The city restricts traffic in the old town on weekends.
example.zh: 这座城市周末限制老城区的交通。

senses.en: to keep something within a particular limit or range

example.en: Please restrict your comments to the topic under discussion.
example.zh: 请把你的评论限定在讨论的话题内。

senses.en: to limit someone's movement or access to a place

example.en: Visitors are restricted to the main exhibition hall.
example.zh: 参观者被限制在主展厅内。

senses.en: with little effort or difficulty

example.en: The door opens easily.
example.zh: 这扇门很容易打开。

senses.en: without doubt; clearly

example.en: She is easily the best candidate.
example.zh: 她无疑是最佳人选。

senses.en: to become smaller or less in amount, number, or quality

example.en: Sales declined sharply last year.
example.zh: 去年销售额大幅下降。

senses.en: to politely refuse an offer or invitation

example.en: She declined the invitation to dinner.
example.zh: 她婉言拒绝了晚餐邀请。

senses.en: a gradual decrease in amount, number, or quality

example.en: The town has seen a decline in tourism.
example.zh: 这个小镇的旅游业出现了下滑。

senses.en: to settle a problem or disagreement

example.en: The two sides met to resolve the dispute.
example.zh: 双方会面以解决争端。

senses.en: to decide firmly to do something

example.en: She resolved to finish the project before Friday.
example.zh: 她决心在周五前完成这个项目。

senses.en: strong determination to do something

example.en: His resolve never wavered during the long campaign.
example.zh: 在漫长的活动中，他的决心从未动摇。

senses.en: to criticize someone sharply or angrily

example.en: The manager rebuked him for missing the deadline.
example.zh: 经理因他错过截止日期而斥责了他。

senses.en: an act of sharp criticism or censure

example.en: She received a stern rebuke from her boss.
example.zh: 她受到了老板严厉的斥责。

senses.en: Adolf Hitler, the German Nazi dictator during World War II (1889–1945)

example.en: Adolf Hitler led Germany from 1933 to 1945.
example.zh: 阿道夫·希特勒在1933年至1945年间统治德国。

senses.en: a unit of force in the SI system, equal to the force needed to accelerate one kilogram by one meter per second squared
senses.zh: 牛顿（力的单位，符号 N）

example.en: A force of one newton will accelerate a one-kilogram mass by one meter per second squared.
example.zh: 一牛顿的力能使一千克质量的物体产生1米每二次方秒的加速度。

senses.en: Isaac Newton (1642–1727), the English physicist and mathematician who formulated the laws of motion and universal gravitation
senses.zh: 牛顿（英国物理学家、数学家，提出运动定律和万有引力定律）

example.en: Isaac Newton developed the theory of universal gravitation.
example.zh: 艾萨克·牛顿提出了万有引力理论。

senses.en: in a way that relates to society

example.en: The policy is socially significant.
example.zh: 这项政策具有重要的社会意义。

senses.en: in social situations; sociably

example.en: He is shy and finds it hard to interact socially.
example.zh: 他很害羞，难以与人社交。

senses.en: pleased because you got what you wanted or needed

example.en: She was satisfied with her exam results.
example.zh: 她对考试结果感到满意。

senses.en: a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces, about 0.45 kilograms; abbreviation of pound

example.en: The package weighs five lbs.
example.zh: 这个包裹重五磅。

senses.en: a person who is eating a meal, especially in a restaurant

example.en: The diners enjoyed their meals by the window.
example.zh: 用餐者们在窗边享用他们的饭菜。

senses.en: a small cheap restaurant in the US, often open late

example.en: We stopped for coffee at a roadside diner.
example.zh: 我们在路边一家小餐馆停下来喝咖啡。

senses.en: the beginning of something, especially something unpleasant

example.en: Symptoms usually appear at the onset of the illness.
example.zh: 症状通常在疾病开始时出现。

senses.en: a military attack

example.en: The troops prepared for the onset at dawn.
example.zh: 部队准备在黎明发起进攻。

senses.en: a large animal with four legs that people ride and use to pull loads

example.en: She learned to ride a horse at her uncle's farm.
example.zh: 她在叔叔的农场学会了骑马。

senses.en: a padded gymnastic apparatus with legs that athletes jump over

example.en: The gymnast performed a difficult routine on the horse.
example.zh: 体操运动员在鞍马上完成了一套高难度动作。

senses.en: to provide or ride on a horse (of a soldier or rider)

example.en: The soldiers were horsed before the journey began.
example.zh: 士兵们在出发前配备了马匹。

senses.en: showing disrespect for religion or sacred things

example.en: He was criticized for his profane remarks about the ritual.
example.zh: 他因对仪式的不敬言论受到批评。

senses.en: not religious; worldly

example.en: Sacred music was played alongside profane songs at the festival.
example.zh: 节日期间，宗教音乐与世俗歌曲一同演奏。

senses.en: to treat something sacred with disrespect

example.en: Vandals profaned the ancient temple.
example.zh: 破坏者亵渎了这座古庙。

senses.en: (of language or behaviour) vulgar; obscene

example.en: The coach apologized for his profane language.
example.zh: 教练为自己的污言秽语道了歉。

senses.en: a person who tends to expect the worst

example.en: A pessimist always expects things to go wrong.
example.zh: 悲观者总是预计事情会出问题。

senses.en: a print made by lithography

example.en: The gallery sells original lithographs by famous artists.
example.zh: 这家画廊出售著名艺术家的原版石版画。

senses.en: to print using lithography

example.en: The poster was lithographed in the 1920s.
example.zh: 这张海报是二十世纪二十年代平版印刷的。

senses.en: a sweet sauce or dessert made from milk and eggs

example.en: She poured warm custard over the apple pie.
example.zh: 她把温热的蛋奶沙司浇在苹果派上。

senses.en: remarks or behavior that ridicule or show contempt for someone

example.en: His cruel mockery of her accent hurt her feelings.
example.zh: 他对她口音的刻薄嘲弄伤害了她的感情。

senses.en: a situation or act that makes something seem worthless or absurd

example.en: The unfair trial was a mockery of justice.
example.zh: 这场不公正的审判是对正义的嘲弄。

senses.en: easily irritated; in a bad mood

example.en: He gets cranky when he doesn't get enough sleep.
example.zh: 他睡眠不足时会变得烦躁易怒。

senses.en: (especially North American) strange or eccentric

example.en: My grandfather has some cranky ideas about modern art.
example.zh: 我祖父对现代艺术有一些古怪的想法。

senses.en: to complain about or express regret over something

example.en: Fans bemoaned the team's poor performance.
example.zh: 球迷们哀叹球队糟糕的表现。

senses.en: full of stars or looking like stars

example.en: We walked home under a starry sky.
example.zh: 我们在繁星满天的夜空下走回家。

senses.en: good at noticing and paying attention to details
senses.zh: 观察力敏锐的；善于观察的

example.en: An observant teacher can tell when a student is struggling.
example.zh: 善于观察的老师能发现学生什么时候遇到困难。

senses.en: belonging to or connected with people or things already mentioned

example.en: The students put their books on the desks.
example.zh: 学生们把他们的书放在课桌上。

senses.en: used to refer to a singular person whose gender is not specified
senses.zh: （指性别不详的单数人）其；他们的

example.en: Each child should bring their own lunch.
example.zh: 每个孩子都应自带午餐。

senses.en: an arranged meeting at a particular time and place

example.en: I have a dentist appointment at three.
example.zh: 我三点钟有个牙医预约。

senses.en: a job or official position

example.en: She accepted an appointment as head of the department.
example.zh: 她接受了系主任的职位。

senses.en: the act of choosing someone for a position or job

example.en: The committee approved the appointment of a new director.
example.zh: 委员会批准了对新主任的任命。

senses.en: not done in a straight or direct way; going through something in between

example.en: The evidence against him is indirect.
example.zh: 针对他的证据是间接的。

senses.en: not saying something plainly; avoiding a direct statement

example.en: His reply was polite but indirect.
example.zh: 他的答复很客气，但不直截了当。

senses.en: a performer in a circus who wears funny makeup and clothes to make people laugh
senses.zh: 小丑（马戏团里逗乐观众的演员）

example.en: The clown juggled five balls at the circus.
example.zh: 马戏团里的小丑同时抛接五个球。

senses.en: someone who behaves in a silly way to amuse others
senses.zh: 爱逗乐的人；行为滑稽的人

example.en: He's the class clown who always makes everyone laugh.
example.zh: 他是班上总把大家逗笑的活宝。

senses.en: to behave in a silly way to make people laugh

example.en: Stop clowning around and get back to work.
example.zh: 别再胡闹了，回去干活。

senses.en: the legal state of being unable to pay one's debts

example.en: The company filed for bankruptcy after failing to repay its loans.
example.zh: 该公司因无法偿还贷款而申请破产。

senses.en: a complete lack or loss of something abstract

example.en: The scandal revealed a bankruptcy of leadership within the organization.
example.zh: 这起丑闻暴露了该组织领导力的彻底匮乏。

senses.en: based on reason; sensible and logical

example.en: She gave a rational explanation for her decision.
example.zh: 她为自己的决定给出了合理的解释。

senses.en: a number that can be written as a fraction of two integers (mathematics)

example.en: One half is a rational number.
example.zh: 二分之一是一个有理数。

senses.en: a sea voyage taken for pleasure

example.en: We went on a cruise around the Mediterranean.
example.zh: 我们进行了一次地中海游轮之旅。

senses.en: to travel or move at a steady, moderate speed

example.en: The ship cruises along the coast at twenty knots.
example.zh: 这艘船以二十节的速度沿海岸巡航。

senses.en: to drive or walk around slowly looking for something or with no particular purpose

example.en: Taxis cruise the streets looking for passengers.
example.zh: 出租车在街上缓慢行驶寻找乘客。

senses.en: the act of refusing to accept, approve, or agree to something

example.en: Her job application ended in rejection.
example.zh: 她的求职申请最终被拒绝了。

senses.en: refusal to accept someone romantically or socially, or the feeling caused by this

example.en: He feared rejection when he asked her out.
example.zh: 约她出去时，他害怕被拒绝。

senses.en: the body's refusal to accept transplanted tissue or an organ

example.en: The patient's body showed signs of organ rejection.
example.zh: 患者的身体出现了器官排斥反应的迹象。

senses.en: relating to atoms

example.en: Scientists study atomic structure to understand matter.
example.zh: 科学家研究原子结构以了解物质。

senses.en: using or involving nuclear energy, especially in weapons

example.en: The country developed atomic weapons during the war.
example.zh: 该国在战争期间研制了核武器。

senses.en: a comparison between two things to show how they are similar

example.en: The teacher explained the heart's function by analogy with a pump.
example.zh: 老师用泵来类比解释心脏的功能。

senses.en: similarity or partial agreement between things

example.en: There is a close analogy between the two processes.
example.zh: 这两个过程之间有很密切的相似之处。

senses.en: to officially approve a treaty, agreement, or law

example.en: Parliament voted to ratify the trade agreement last week.
example.zh: 议会上周投票批准了该贸易协定。

senses.en: an elaborate public show, often with colorful costumes and scenes from history
senses.zh: 露天历史剧表演；盛大庆典

example.en: The town staged a pageant to celebrate its founding.
example.zh: 小镇举办了一场历史剧表演来庆祝建镇。

senses.en: a competition in which people, usually women, are judged on beauty and poise

example.en: She won the national beauty pageant.
example.zh: 她赢得了全国选美比赛。

senses.en: a small waterfall or a series of them

example.en: A beautiful cascade runs down the mountain side.
example.zh: 一道美丽的小瀑布沿山坡流下。

senses.en: a succession of stages or events happening one after another

example.en: The delay caused a cascade of problems.
example.zh: 延误引发了一连串问题。

senses.en: to fall or pour down in large quantities

example.en: Water cascaded down the rocks.
example.zh: 水从岩石上倾泻而下。

senses.en: a person whose business is arranging funerals and burying or cremating the dead

example.en: The undertaker arranged the funeral service for the family.
example.zh: 殡葬承办人为这家人安排了葬礼。

senses.en: having two sides or parts that are not the same in shape or size

example.en: The building has an asymmetric design with one tall tower.
example.zh: 这栋楼的设计不对称，只有一座高塔。

senses.en: talking too much about unimportant things

example.en: A garrulous old man kept the bus talking for the whole trip.
example.zh: 一位喋喋不休的老人在整段车程中一直讲话。

senses.en: a deep vivid red color

example.en: The sky turned a brilliant crimson at sunset.
example.zh: 日落时天空变成绚丽的深红色。

senses.en: deep red in color

example.en: She wore a crimson dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿了一条深红色的裙子去参加聚会。

senses.en: to turn red, especially from embarrassment or shame

example.en: His face crimsoned when everyone looked at him.
example.zh: 当大家都看着他时，他的脸涨红了。

senses.en: to make something ineffective or invalid

example.en: One typo negated weeks of careful work.
example.zh: 一个笔误使几周的细心工作付诸东流。

senses.en: to deny the truth of something

example.en: He negated all the accusations against him.
example.zh: 他否认了对他的所有指控。

senses.en: the order in which events happen in time

example.en: The book presents the events of the war in strict chronology.
example.zh: 这本书按严格的时间顺序呈现战争事件。

senses.en: a list or record of events arranged in the order they occurred

example.en: The appendix includes a chronology of the author's life.
example.zh: 附录包括作者的生平年表。

senses.en: having an unpleasant smell

example.en: The gym locker room was really smelly.
example.zh: 健身房的更衣室真的很臭。
